title: PlannerPlanRequest
description: The `backlog-planner` `POST /plans` request body (`youtrack/planner/src/backlog_planner/api.py`'s `PlanBody`). Exactly one of `project` / `newProject` must be given -- picking an existing project or defining one to create.

project.description: The id of an existing project (`planner.project.id`).

name.description: Display name for the project to create.

shortKey.description: Short key for the project to create, upper-cased before this pattern is checked.

prompt.description: The planning prompt. The planner caps it at 20000 characters after trimming; this schema does not enforce that upper bound.
